items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: I don't know any of them. ... I wouldn't know, I've heard from them people in, or better than eight or ten years.

ctx.x: Those are brothers of yours, not your father's?
Half brothers of mine. Of mine.
Of yours, yeah. My father's sons, on the other side, on the other half. Yeah, I see, half brother of yours.
